label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 59
title: UI gating: operator pages only on operator instance
body:
## Original (as captured)
Render /operator/* only when INSTANCE_ROLE=operator AND platform_admin; customer admins never see operator surfaces.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0069)
INSTANCE_ROLE operator|tenant + platform_admin role; all operator endpoints require operator instance + platform_admin (tenant tokens -> 403). Same codebase across local/dev/Vercel/self-host.
